description: This PHP source file defines the RegistrationEventQueue class, which maps to the database table 'ohrm_registration_event_queue' in a Human Resource Management system. It includes class constants for event types, properties with ORM annotations, and getter/setter methods for managing registration event queue entries.

classes.name: RegistrationEventQueue
classes.description: Represents an entity for queuing registration events, with properties for event type, timestamps, publication status, and associated data, mapped via Doctrine ORM to the database table 'ohrm_registration_event_queue'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the queue entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the queue entry.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of the registration event.

methods.name: setEventType
methods.description: Sets the type of the registration event.

methods.name: isPublished
methods.description: Checks if the event has been published.

methods.name: setPublished
methods.description: Sets the published status of the event.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the event.

methods.name: getPublishTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the event was published.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data associated with the event.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the data associated with the event.
